item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-R07-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-R07-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-R07-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The article assesses the military strategy’s results as mixed, citing persistent violence, operational limitations of the army, and significant humanitarian consequences.","notes":["The excerpt supports these as reasons associated with the mixed assessment, but does not establish that the strategy itself caused the humanitarian consequences."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-R07-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-R07-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-R07-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The article concludes that durable peace depends on combining military coercion with credible, inclusive dialogue and deep reforms in governance, justice, and local development; neither force alone nor dialogue alone can guarantee stability.","notes":["The correction preserves the excerpt’s present-tense analytical conclusion and avoids converting it into a separate historical finding."]}]}
